title: Comparing Cast Iron and PVC for Drainage DWV Systems
description: Selecting the right piping material for drainage waste and vent systems depends on noise control, structural demands, and site conditions. Cast iron soil pipe excels in acoustic dampening, making it ideal for multi-story vertical stacks where waste drop noise must be minimized. It also provides excellent fire resistance and structural rigidity. Conversely, Schedule 40 PVC offers superior chemical and corrosion resistance, smooth interior walls that support consistent flow, and lightweight handling that speeds up installation. Understanding these core material characteristics allows professionals to specify the optimal drainage material based on acoustic goals and building requirements.
